name: Ship Desk
tagline: Staged release desk that keeps checkout switched off until you flip the go switch
description: Walks a product from staging to production one locked promote at a time, so a release only goes live when you say so. Checkout stays fail-closed until you explicitly turn it on, which keeps accidental buy buttons off a launch while it is still moving.
author: usgworld
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
